title: Never Get Ghosted by a Recruiter Again (Do This Instead)
description:
Recruiters ignore most LinkedIn messages — not because candidates aren’t qualified, but because the message is sent the wrong way.

This Short shows the one change that helps recruiter messages get a response instead of being ignored.

 Watch the full video for the complete recruiter DM template and strategy.

transcript: Tired of getting ghosted after sending recruiter DMs and hearing crickets? Here's the fix. A recruiter DM works best after you've already applied. That way, you're not a random message you're a real candidate tied to a real role they're recruiting for. The mistake most people make is pitching themselves. Don't do that. A strong recruiter message does three things. It names the role you applied for, shows how you're aligned to the problem the role is meant to solve, and ends with an insider level question. For example, asking something at the end of your message, like with your expansion into new markets, where are you seeing the most friction between speed and consistency? And how is this role meant to help balance that? That's how you start a real conversation without sounding awkward or pushy. I'm breaking this all down step by step in my get seen series with the exact DM template. It's all linked in the comments. Follow me at Kersner Careers. Let's get you seen and get you hired.
